recovery_roundtrip.semantic_identity_rule: Recovered canonical semantic message hash equals the pre-roundtrip canonical semantic message hash on every supported case.
recovery_roundtrip.historical_identity_rule: A distinct transition receipt records UNITY/SERVICE/RECOVERY, so equal semantic state does not erase transition history.

scope_firewalls.opaque_definition: Opaque in v9.1 means the explicit generator-family and expected-language labels are withheld from the candidate. It does NOT mean the CNF syntax is information-theoretically opaque. The frozen detectors intentionally exploit exact recognizable 2-CNF parity-pair and 3-variable XOR clause-block structure.
scope_firewalls.roundtrip_definition: The typed BOOL-DAG bridge is a controlled exact representation roundtrip for the two supported languages. It is not yet a universal cross-language compiler and does not solve arbitrary mixed-language composition.
scope_firewalls.finite_polynomial_signature_definition: G9 checks only the preregistered finite cost thresholds on the frozen widths. It is not an asymptotic complexity proof.
scope_firewalls.hostile_refusal_definition: Correct refusal on mixed EQ+XOR diagnoses the frozen portfolio only; it is not evidence that no exact compact representation exists for that relation.
scope_firewalls.auditor_definition: The 10438 exhaustive assignments are evaluation-only independent bounded auditing. They are separately counted and do not feed discovery, compilation, JOIN, projection, roundtrip, or theorem-complexity claims.

central_lesson: For two preregistered syntactically recognizable exact families, JANUS can withhold family labels, discover the appropriate semantic language, execute JOIN and EXISTS projection, roundtrip through a typed stable representation, replay canonically, preserve semantic identity while adding provenance, and do so with zero solver-side full-boundary enumeration on the frozen scope. The first unsupported mixed-language relation is correctly refused rather than partially compiled. The theorem-critical gap therefore moves to exact cross-language service/composition and then to family-independent arbitrary-CNF discovery/coverage.

next_frontier.goal: Turn the v9.1 mixed EQ+XOR correct refusal into a proof-carrying exact service path: discover components without family labels, compose them in an exact mixed representation, perform JOIN/EXISTS/canonicalization, and either recover/switch languages with receipts or return OPEN. Charge bridge discovery, translation, verification, bit complexity, switching and cumulative debt.
next_frontier.killer_condition: No partial-constraint dropping, no truth-table fallback hidden in compilation, no post-hoc language choice, and no compact-output win if any transition pays exponential work.
next_frontier.promotion_boundary: Finite v9.2 success may establish a typed mixed-language lemma only. Arbitrary-CNF universal coverage and polynomial lifecycle remain separate OPEN gates.
